endorsements.quote: Recommendations related to dataset compositions, particularly public dataset composition, should promote data diversity and allow for identification and reduction of bias within the dataset.
Undoubtably more insight into data origin and other changes made to the data along its lifecycle would help to identify and address bias within large datasets.
Datasets should be meticulously examined for innate biases, and research outputs should be required to discuss potential biases within the underlying data.
Greater insight into who is accessing the data, for what purpose, and when is essential.

unlisted_practices: Record rich metadata alongside surgical video data, including contextual information on metadata access and use, to protect privacy.
Grant access to surgical video data on a use-case-specific basis that favors public benefit and requires disclosure of purpose, duration, and expected outcome.
Have ethics boards, institutional review boards, and patient safety organizations grant access to surgical video data.
Establish universal standardized guidelines for surgical video data collection, structuring, storage, and processing.
Store surgical video data with a standardized, configurable data architecture to improve interoperability.
Separately store PHI, audio data, and out-of-body images removed from surgical videos to comply with privacy law.
Educate patients about their surgical video data, their rights, and its use so they can make informed decisions.
Set video data structure decisions at the institution level rather than through strict mandates that disincentivize recording.
Validate foundation models on diverse and representative datasets to ensure generalizable, accurate, and fair results.
Record surgical video with priority on holistic data acquisition and include rare and complicated cases to ensure data diversity.
Include patient representatives and lawmakers in future decision-making on surgical data science.
Explore human factors in the clinical use of AI to understand product utilization and value.
Enable other stakeholders to access data collected for a specific use only when proper agreements and permissions are in place.
Establish regulations protecting surgeons to incentivize operating-room video recording.

screen.reason: This is a consensus statement offering recommendations and guidelines for surgical video data use, structure, and governance for AI research and clinical quality improvement.
